grammar.summary: 本课学习 despite 表让步与 used to 表曾经存在。

points.title: despite 表让步
points.explanation: Despite its popularity, ... = 尽管（= in spite of），后接名词，不接从句。

examples.en: Despite the name, the machine is not a gold mine.
examples.cn: 尽管名字如此，这台机器并非金矿。

points.title: used to 表曾经
points.explanation: The machine was used in a cave... used to do 表过去常常；be used to doing 表习惯于，两者勿混。

examples.en: It is used for detecting gold.
